{{Quote|You wouldn't know Bal'far unless you studied the early history of the Alliance. But he was one of Bail Organa's first supporters among the Bothans, and has helped recruit many SpyNet installations to our cause. If he falls here, it will harm our struggle in this entire sector. Will you escort Bal'far?|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Herosk Bal'far''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating Bal'far and escorting him back to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Although the spacer was attacked by [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Naberrie's mission was completed.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Herosk Bal'far was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Players who performed a series of [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for [[W:c:swg:Pooja Naberrie|Pooja Naberrie]] had to locate Bal'far and escort him safely back to [[W:c:swg:Dee'ja Peak|Dee'ja Peak]]. However, due to a bug, many of the NPCs in Naberrie's quests were not properly sequenced. For instance, in the quest to escort Bal'far, players actually encountered an individual known as [[Jumis]], who was supposed to appear in the following quest. The character model for Herosk Bal'far likewise erroneously spawned for Naberrie's sixth and final quest, in which the player was supposed to encounter an individual named [[Melloc Fitzal]].<ref name="AED" /> According to the game files, Bal'far could not be properly escorted, as the character (in this case Jumis), was not designated as an "escort" NPC.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> Nevertheless, it was possible for the player to complete the mission and advance to the next quest. This article assumes that the content of Naberrie's quest dialogue is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that Bal'far, not Jumis, actually appeared during her second quest.<ref name="AED" />

Furthermore, because Herosk Bal'far spawned under the generic "noble" template, his appearance was randomized under one of forty-two possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Bal'far could appear as included Bothans, [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either gender. Because the quest dialogue identified Bal'far as a male Bothan, this article assumes that the randomly generated male Bothan depiction is canon in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity. The questline that involved Bal'far was eventually removed from the game when Pooja Naberrie was relocated to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] as part of the newly introduced [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]], released as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
